deliverables: Milestone-based disbursement controls through TRSC and PSSC smart contracts
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Mithril Protocol continuous development through Intersect on behalf of the vendor Teragone.

claims.claim: Mithril addresses slow full-node synchronization and centralized-trust light-client access by using stake-based threshold multi-signatures to certify Cardano state in a trustless way.
The proposal says faster sync times would lower onboarding friction and unlock tooling for exchanges, wallets, and monitoring.
The proposal states Mithril enables community-built bridges, light wallets, full wallets, light clients, and monitoring tools around Cardano.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested withdrawal is stated not to breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.
The budget allocates 3,699,440 ADA to Mithril Protocol Continuous Development and 110,983 ADA to the Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Audit and oversight costs are included in the proposal overhead and administration fee, with independent oversight through Intersect and technically capable third parties.
Teragone has not previously received direct funding from Cardano treasury or community governance programs but has worked on Mithril through IOG-funded collaboration.

Intersect plans to administer funds using Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multisig-style authorization thresholds, and external oversight entities.
A dashboard is provided for the community to audit and track the withdrawn ADA, TRSC, and PSSC metrics with on-chain verifiability.

summary: The document requests 3,810,423 ADA for Mithril Protocol continuous development, routed to an Intersect treasury reserve smart contract with oversight and milestone-disbursement controls, but it does not provide a complete proposal summary, detailed feasibility analysis, risk analysis, alternatives analysis, failure-mode analysis, or granular budget justification.
